summary: Wednesday's close reflected markets digesting Tuesday's midterm election results: capital rotated into consumer staples and Treasuries while tech and semiconductors lagged behind a broad, equal-weighted equity rally. Falling yields extended the bond advance, gold slipped as haven demand cooled, and elevated volatility kept the mood guarded.
tweet: Midterm election fallout drove a rotation into staples and bonds Wednesday, broadening the equity rally while tech and gold lagged.
